text:
kelly_marketing: Quick sync — aiming to announce Release X next Tue 10:00am PT. Need: final changelog link, canonical docs URL (staging ok), canary + ramp windows, and a 2–3 line benchmark nugget for the blog. Also planning a follow-up webinar (30 min) — can we lock a webinar slot and who owns the demo? :rocket:

sam_eng: I can drop the changelog link. Using GH draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelogs/pull/482 — final commit sha `c3f8b2a`. Canary starts at 10:00 PT for 5m, then 20% ramp 10:05, full at 10:20. If anything fails we roll to fallback-model-v1. :+1:

priya_docs: Docs are published to staging: https://docs.redwood.dev/staging/release-x (password-protected until publish). I'll add the quickstart and migration notes today. Need marketing copy for the header (one sentence).

kelly_marketing: Perfect — can you paste the canonical staging URL into the announcement draft when ready? Also, webinar slot — thinking Wed 11am PT (30 min) for customers + press. Evan, you good to lead demo? :eyes:

ev an_pm: Wed 11am PT works for me. I'll run the demo with Priya on docs and Nico on benchmarks. Marketing, can you confirm promotional email timing? We want email to hit ~5m after full rollout.

nico_research: Short benchmark nugget: 2.4x cost reduction on long-context LMs (8k->32k) when using adaptive batching + KV caching; 95th pct latency down from 430ms to 210ms at 16k tokens. Draft blurb: "Redwood Reduce: up to 2.4x lower token cost and ~50% lower 95th-percentile latency on long-context workloads." Want us to run one more regression overnight to be safe. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

kelly_marketing: That blurb is gold. We'll put it first line under TL;DR. Please confirm regression by 9am PT tomorrow so we can finalize numbers.

sam_eng: Regression run queued — results by 08:45 PT. One heads-up: the canary config toggles quantized-paths; keep support on standby for ~15 minutes after full rollout.

priya_docs: Quick UX note: migration page includes `compatibility` section and `config` snippet. I'll paste the snippet here when ready:

```
# example config
model:
  name: redwood-x
  quantize: true
  kv_cache: auto
```

kelly_marketing: Awesome. For the announcement post timeline I'm proposing: 10:00 PT canary, 10:20 full, 10:25 public blog + docs link, 10:30 email, 11:00 webinar promo (reminder). Any objections?

sam_eng: fine by eng. Make sure the runbook includes fallback to `redwood-x-legacy` and a deploy rollback command: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/reinference --to-revision=3`.

ev an_pm: Locked. I'll own the runbook page and the webinar slide deck. Please add questions you'd like Nico to answer.

deploy-bot: Scheduled release-x deployment: start=5512345600, canary-window=5m, full-rollout=5512345720. CI: all checks passed. :white_check_mark:

kelly_marketing: Thanks all — I'll draft the announcement and post in #marketing by EOD for review. Tagging final checklist: changelog link, staging docs URL, benchmark sentence, webinar time, email send window. Ping me here with any last-minute changes. :wave:
